# Liver Abnormalities in Pregnancy

| Condition    | Intrahepatic Cholestasis                           | HELLP Syndrome                                           | Acute Fatty Liver                                                          | Hyperemesis Gravidarum                                  | Acute viral hepatitis                                                               |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Timing**   | 3rd tri                                            | 3rd tri                                                  | 3rd tri                                                                    | 1st tri                                                 | any                                                                                 |
| **Features** | *Jaundice, Pruritus*                               | PEC, RUQ, n/v<br>headache/<br>vision Δ’s,<br>edema       | sudden jaundice, RUQ,<br>n/v,<br>ascites                                   | Vomiting, dehydration                                   | prodrome: fever, n/v, RUQ, hepmeg<br><br>icteric: jaundice, pruritus, *pale stools* |
| **Dx**       | *↑ Bile acids*, <br>↑ ALT/AST, <br>*↑ direct bili* | Hemolysis (↑ ind bili), <br>↑ AST/ALT, <br>*↓ platelets* | ↑ AST/ALT, ↑ bili, ↑ PT/INR, <br>*↓ glucose<br>*<br><br>conf: U/S, *↑ WBC* | mild ↑AST/ALT<br>↑ bili,<br>↓ K, <br>↑ ketonuria        | ↑ ALT/AST, ↑ ALP                                                                    |
| **Pearl**    | ↑ Bile acids                                       | ↓ platelets                                              | ↓ glucose<br>                                                              | ↓ K, ↑ ketonur                                          | fever, hepmeg                                                                       |
| **AST/ALT**  | ↑                                                  | ↑                                                        | ↑                                                                          | mild ↑                                                  | ↑                                                                                   |
| **Tx**       | *ursodeoxycholic acid + deliv at 36-39wks*         | transfuse,<br>antiHTN, Mag, *deliver immed if HD instab* | *immediate* delivery                                                       | B6 <br>$\pm$ anti-H1 <br>$\pm$ ondans,<br>IVF,<br>lytes | supportive                                                                          |
| **Compl**    | FGR<br>death<br>preterm                            | abruption<br>DIC<br>ARDS<br>demise<br>preterm            | hydrops                                                                    | recurrence<br>FGR<br>preterm                            | ALF<br>demise                                                                       |

*This table was presented to Cristian Bell, another MS3 with me on Gyn Onc service during my OBGYN clerkship.*
